Heatmap of monthly returns by year

Source: R/fct_plots.R
plot_returns_calendar.Rd

Months are colored from red to green by their return. The color limit is the 95th percentile of the absolute returns, so a few extreme months do not wash out the rest.

Usage

plot_returns_calendar(calendar, label = NULL, mode = "light")

Arguments

calendar

Matrix from monthly_returns().

label

Label of the coin for the title, or NULL for none.

mode

"light" (the default) or "dark", to suit a light or dark page.

Value

A plotly object.

Examples

btc <- get_history("Bitcoin (BTC)", as.Date("2013-04-29"))
#> ❯ Scraping historical crypto data
#> 
#> ❯ Processing historical crypto data
#> 
plot_returns_calendar(monthly_returns(btc), "Bitcoin (BTC)")
